schema.title: Visual Variable Legend Options
schema.description: Options available for the legend for visual variables.

showLegend.description: Indicates whether to show the color/size/opacity ramp in the legend.

instructions: Can you add another entry to the "customValues" list that’s exactly the same as the first item?

modification.precise_instruction: Add another item to the "customValues" list, identical to its first item.
